title: Exact CPU baselines for the GPU range scorer
status: protocol registered 2026-11-17; no recorded run yet
question: How much faster is the GPU range scorer than an exact sequential and an exact multicore CPU scorer on the same machine, index, queries and answers?
hypothesis: The GPU scorer is much faster than one CPU core; the multicore scorer narrows the gap but scales sub-linearly because exhaustive scoring is memory-bound.
motivation: No measured CPU latency exists at full scale; the course asks for speedup over sequential and over state-of-the-art implementations.
correctness_rule: Every configuration's ordered (original_id, score) top-10 equals the pinned CPU reference for every query, in correctness and in every timing process.
success_rule: A complete run under the registered protocol; the result is reported whatever the speedups are.
failure_rule: Any mismatch, rejected expected run, or more than 3 ineligible processes for one configuration.
